title: A2A server shallow-merges user and workspace settings, causing nested config to be lost

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue clearly describes a bug in A2A server configuration merging where top-level object spreading causes nested user settings to be lost when overridden by workspace settings. It includes reproduction examples, expected versus actual behavior, and references to the exact codebase locations.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The fix requires updating the object merge logic in a single source file (packages/a2a-server/src/config/settings.ts) to perform deep object merging for nested setting sections, and updating unit tests in packages/a2a-server/src/config/settings.test.ts.

summary.problem: A2A server settings loading uses a shallow object spread when combining user and workspace settings, causing nested settings objects to be completely overwritten.
summary.root_cause: In packages/a2a-server/src/config/settings.ts, loadSettings combines userSettings and workspaceSettings with { ...userSettings, ...workspaceSettings }. When workspaceSettings contains a nested object, all unmentioned properties in userSettings for that object are replaced rather than merged.
summary.context: Nested configuration sections like fileFiltering, tools, telemetry, and experimental in workspace settings should selectively override specific fields while retaining global defaults set in user settings.

steps: Implement or utilize a deep merge utility in packages/a2a-server/src/config/settings.ts to recursively merge nested setting objects (such as fileFiltering, tools, telemetry, and experimental) between userSettings and workspaceSettings.
Update loadSettings to perform a deep merge of workspaceSettings onto userSettings instead of a shallow object spread.
Ensure security-sensitive properties policyPaths and adminPolicyPaths continue to strictly use values from userSettings regardless of workspace settings.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Workspace settings deep merge with user settings so that partial overrides in workspace settings retain unmentioned nested properties from user settings.
verification_steps: Update existing test 'should overwrite top-level settings from workspace (shallow merge)' in packages/a2a-server/src/config/settings.test.ts to expect nested user keys (e.g., enableRecursiveFileSearch) to be preserved when workspace settings specify only a subset of fields (e.g., respectGitIgnore).
Add additional unit tests verifying deep merge functionality across other nested configuration fields like tools or experimental.
